name: Helping The Homeless
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively support those who have fallen into poverty, emphasizing compassion and tangible aid even to strangers or sojourners, as seen in Leviticus 25:35. The Proverbs passages highlight that showing kindness to the poor is pleasing to God and brings blessing, while ignoring their cries invites judgment. Isaiah 58:6 underscores that true fasting involves freeing the oppressed and breaking burdens, illustrating that helping the homeless is a vital expression of righteousness and obedience to God.
